instruction: Fix ledger.py. total(text) parses CSV with headers category,amount, using standard CSV quoting (quoted commas and quoted multiline fields are allowed). Category matching strips outer whitespace and is case insensitive. Sum Decimal amounts only for category sale, subtract amounts for refund, and ignore other categories entirely. Ignore rows whose amount is not a finite valid Decimal. Return a Decimal; never use float. Blank input returns Decimal(0). Run `python3 test_ledger.py`; do not edit tests. Support arbitrary rows, not just test examples. Return DONE after verification. Work only inside the current directory.
